parts.zh: M：早上好。我叫鲍勃·费特曼
W：上周不是我打电话叫你来的吗？
M：可能吧？我为 Alpha Maintenance 工作
W：是的，我上周二，也就是十天前
M：很抱歉，但我不负责安排所有的后勤事宜
W：我明白了。不过我要告诉你
M：我明白，也很抱歉给你带来不便
W：就是这台机器。它运行缓慢有一阵子了
M：好的。你知道它有没有备份吗？
M：我的意思是，你知道里面的内容有没有被复制并保存到其他地方吗？

items.stem: What did the woman do last Tuesday?

choices.text: Met the computer technician.
choices.zh: 见了电脑技术员。

choices.text: Told the man about her trouble.
choices.zh: 把她的麻烦告诉了这位男士。

choices.text: Called the man's company.
choices.zh: 给这位男士的公司打了电话。

choices.text: Visited Alpha Maintenance.
choices.zh: 拜访了Alpha Maintenance。

items.stem: What does the man say he did when he got the call?

choices.text: Consulted someone in charge.
choices.zh: 咨询了负责人。

choices.text: Came as soon as possible.
choices.zh: 尽快赶来了。

choices.text: Informed the central office at once.
choices.zh: 立即通知了中心办公室。

choices.text: Designated an engineer to the case.
choices.zh: 指派了一名工程师处理此事。

items.stem: What is the feeling about the problem around the woman's workplace?

choices.text: Frustration.
choices.zh: 沮丧。

choices.text: Intimidation.
choices.zh: 恐惧。

choices.text: Desperation.
choices.zh: 绝望。

choices.text: Indignation.
choices.zh: 愤慨。

items.stem: What does the woman say her manager would know?

choices.text: Whether the contents have been backed up.
choices.zh: 内容是否已备份。

choices.text: Whether they can find help somewhere else.
choices.zh: 他们能否在别处找到帮助。

choices.text: Whether all data stored on the hard drive has got lost.
choices.zh: 存储在硬盘上的所有数据是否已丢失。

choices.text: Whether they need to wipe the system directories clean.
choices.zh: 他们是否需要清除系统目录。

items.stem: What will many people say about a career in law?

choices.text: It's boring.
choices.zh: 它很无聊。

choices.text: It's challenging.
choices.zh: 它很有挑战性。

choices.text: It's a beautiful thing.
choices.zh: 它是一件美好的事情。

choices.text: It's unlike most jobs.
choices.zh: 它不同于大多数工作。

items.stem: What does the man say most of his work involves?

choices.text: Arbitrating between disagreeing solicitors.
choices.zh: 在意见不一的律师之间进行仲裁。

choices.text: Preventing disputes from escalating.
choices.zh: 防止争议升级。

choices.text: Buying and selling property.
choices.zh: 买卖房产。

choices.text: Mediating land disputes.
choices.zh: 调解土地纠纷。

items.stem: Why does the man say it's usually better to resolve problems outside of court whenever possible?

choices.text: Courts are intended for fixing major legal disputes.
choices.zh: 法庭是用来解决重大法律纠纷的。

choices.text: Courts are getting too bureaucratic to function.
choices.zh: 法庭正变得过于官僚化而无法运作。

choices.text: Courts can be frustrating and expensive.
choices.zh: 法庭可能令人沮丧且费用高昂。

choices.text: Courts can be frightening and arbitrary.
choices.zh: 法庭可能令人恐惧且武断。

items.stem: What does the man think is required of any law professional?

choices.text: The ability to make arguments in a unique way.
choices.zh: 以独特方式进行论证的能力。

choices.text: The skill of preventing conflicts between parties concerned.
choices.zh: 防止相关各方之间冲突的技能。

choices.text: The skill of foreseeing any potential stakes in their work.
choices.zh: 预见工作中任何潜在利害关系的技能。

choices.text: The ability to express themselves clearly and forcefully.
choices.zh: 清晰有力地表达自己的能力。

items.stem: What did the researchers do in their review in the journal Trends in Cognitive Sciences?

choices.text: They looked into the relationship between one's prior knowledge and creativity.
choices.zh: 他们研究了一个人的先验知识与创造力之间的关系。

choices.text: They offered novel ways to help older adults to keep their memories from aging.
choices.zh: 他们提供了帮助老年人防止记忆力衰退的新方法。

choices.text: They proposed an explanation for old people's difficulty in retrieving memories.
choices.zh: 他们对老年人提取记忆困难提出了一种解释。

choices.text: They advanced a new model concerning human information storage and retrieval.
choices.zh: 他们提出了一个关于人类信息存储和提取的新模型。

items.stem: What do several behavioral and brain imaging studies show?

choices.text: Young adults rely on memory while older adults keep notes as a reminder.
choices.zh: 年轻人依赖记忆,而老年人做笔记作为提醒。

choices.text: Older adults often retrieve irrelevant memories along with what they want.
choices.zh: 老年人在提取所需记忆时常常同时提取出不相关的记忆。

choices.text: Young adults accumulate knowledge much more quickly than older adults.
choices.zh: 年轻人积累知识的速度比老年人快得多。

choices.text: Older adults generally perform cognitive tasks much slower than young adults.
choices.zh: 老年人执行认知任务的速度通常比年轻人慢得多。

items.stem: What does evidence suggest regarding older adults?

choices.text: They show preserved, and sometimes enhanced, creativity.
choices.zh: 他们表现出保留的、有时甚至增强的创造力。

choices.text: They frequently suffer from disorderly crowded memories.
choices.zh: 他们经常遭受杂乱拥挤记忆的困扰。

choices.text: They can rely on their accumulated wisdom in an emergency.
choices.zh: 他们在紧急情况下可以依靠自己积累的智慧。

choices.text: They may well be served by forgetting their prior knowledge.
choices.zh: 忘记先验知识可能对他们很有帮助。

items.stem: What do we learn about American workers from the passage?

choices.text: They are actually proud of the goods and services they produce.
choices.zh: 他们实际上为自己生产的商品和服务感到自豪。

choices.text: They are worried about being alienated from the outside world.
choices.zh: 他们担心与外部世界隔绝。

choices.text: They are rarely in control of many things related to their work.
choices.zh: 他们很少能掌控与工作相关的许多事情。

choices.text: They are longing to share the profits made from their work.
choices.zh: 他们渴望分享工作所创造的利润。

items.stem: What does the passage say long working hours contribute to?

choices.text: The steady decrease in productivity.
choices.zh: 生产率的持续下降。

choices.text: The adverse effect on physical health.
choices.zh: 对身体健康的不良影响。

choices.text: The feeling of being time poor.
choices.zh: 时间贫乏的感觉。

choices.text: The rising economic inequality.
choices.zh: 经济不平等的加剧。

items.stem: What does automation do, according to the passage?

choices.text: It alters the structure of work.
choices.zh: 它改变了工作的结构。

choices.text: It puts jobs and wages at risk.
choices.zh: 它使工作和工资面临风险。

choices.text: It liberates people from tedious and laborious work.
choices.zh: 它将人们从繁琐和费力的工作中解放出来。

choices.text: It creates new work opportunities in the IT industry.
choices.zh: 它在信息技术行业创造了新的工作机会。

items.stem: What do post-work theorists advocate?

choices.text: Finding meaning in work.
choices.zh: 在工作中寻找意义。

choices.text: Prioritizing life over work.
choices.zh: 将生活置于工作之上。

choices.text: Improving relationships in the community.
choices.zh: 改善社区中的关系。

choices.text: Realizing one's social value in the workplace.
choices.zh: 在工作场所实现个人的社会价值。

items.stem: What does the speaker say even our personal beliefs about effort can do?

choices.text: Affect our attitude to novel tasks.
choices.zh: 影响我们对新任务的态度。

choices.text: Distinguish us in the social world.
choices.zh: 在社会世界中使我们与众不同。

choices.text: Outweigh IQ in importance.
choices.zh: 在重要性上超过智商。

choices.text: Impact academic achievements.
choices.zh: 影响学业成就。

items.stem: How did the researchers turn on the music toy in their experiment?

choices.text: By pressing a hidden button.
choices.zh: 通过按下一个隐藏的按钮。

choices.text: By pushing a big button on top.
choices.zh: 通过按下顶部的一个大按钮。

choices.text: By pressing two buttons at the same time.
choices.zh: 通过同时按下两个按钮。

choices.text: By helping the babies push the right button.
choices.zh: 通过帮助婴儿按下正确的按钮。

items.stem: What could the infants do in the experiment according to the speaker?

choices.text: Perform difficult tasks successfully just by observing how adults acted.
choices.zh: 仅通过观察成人的行为就能成功完成困难的任务。

choices.text: Make generalizable inferences about persistence from a few examples.
choices.zh: 从少数例子中对坚持做出可推广的推断。

choices.text: Adapt themselves to different social contexts.
choices.zh: 使自己适应不同的社会环境。

choices.text: Work hard to interact with experimenters.
choices.zh: 努力与实验者互动。

items.stem: What is the speaker's purpose of giving this talk?

choices.text: Offering advice on overcoming habitual lateness.
choices.zh: 就克服习惯性迟到提供建议。

choices.text: Exemplifying various recreational opportunities.
choices.zh: 举例说明各种休闲娱乐机会。

choices.text: Scrutinizing individuals' defining traits.
choices.zh: 审视个人的决定性特征。

choices.text: Suggesting ways for setting priorities.
choices.zh: 建议设定优先事项的方法。

items.stem: What should you do if mornings are a struggle for you?

choices.text: Make the breakfast simpler.
choices.zh: 把早餐做得更简单。

choices.text: Take the alarms seriously.
choices.zh: 认真对待闹钟。

choices.text: Ready yourself in the early dawn.
choices.zh: 在清晨做好准备。

choices.text: Get prepared the night before.
choices.zh: 前一天晚上做好准备。

items.stem: According to the speaker, what can we do to combat unexpected delays?

choices.text: Finish the prior task 30 minutes earlier.
choices.zh: 提前30分钟完成前一项任务。

choices.text: Keep ourselves from hitting a bump.
choices.zh: 避免自己遇到障碍。

choices.text: Leave time in between activities.
choices.zh: 在各项活动之间留出时间。

choices.text: Try to avoid possible hold-ups.
choices.zh: 尽量避免可能的耽搁。

items.stem: What do visitors find about the cities they've been to?

choices.text: Their lifestyles vary.
choices.zh: 它们的生活方式各不相同。

choices.text: Their traits vary.
choices.zh: 它们的特征各不相同。

choices.text: They have different customs.
choices.zh: 它们有不同的习俗。

choices.text: They have different feels.
choices.zh: 它们有不同的感觉。

items.stem: What did one study find about Bostonians compared with residents of other U.S. cities?

choices.text: They are not as willing to help strangers.
choices.zh: 他们不太愿意帮助陌生人。

choices.text: They are not as patient with one another.
choices.zh: 他们彼此之间不太有耐心。

choices.text: They violate traffic rules more frequently.
choices.zh: 他们更频繁地违反交通规则。

choices.text: They become more easily irritated in public.
choices.zh: 他们在公共场合更容易被激怒。

items.stem: What does Thomas O'Connor say about the idea of strangers greeting one another?

choices.text: It was practiced by Boston's founding fathers.
choices.zh: 这是Boston建城先辈们践行的做法。

choices.text: It is not deemed exotic by Proper Bostonians.
choices.zh: 正统Boston人并不认为这是异域风俗。

choices.text: It was adopted by Boston's upper class.
choices.zh: 这被Boston上层阶级所采纳。

choices.text: It is not part of Boston's local culture.
choices.zh: 这不是Boston地方文化的一部分。

items.stem: What does the speaker think Boston should do?

choices.text: Stick to its own way of showing courtesy to strangers.
choices.zh: 坚持自己对陌生人表示礼貌的方式。

choices.text: Follow the examples set by Paris and New York City.
choices.zh: 效仿Paris和New York City树立的榜样。

choices.text: Learn from the world's major cities in promoting tourism.
choices.zh: 学习世界主要城市在推广旅游方面的做法。

choices.text: Take pride in its history and adhere to its cultural tradition.
choices.zh: 为其历史感到自豪并坚守其文化传统。
